mutants.name: all_single_digit
mutants.desc: treats every number as a single digit (multiplies by 10 per position)

mutants.name: factorial_n_minus_1
mutants.desc: multiplies by (n-1)! instead of n! in the final step

mutants.name: group_hi_offbyone
mutants.desc: digit-length groups use hi = min(n, 10**d) (10, 100, ... counted one group too early)

mutants.name: no_mod_small
mutants.desc: per-number contribution via subset-size polynomial, but forgets the final modulo

mutants.name: uniform_len_of_n
mutants.desc: treats every number as having as many digits as n
